searchText: Testnet name needed for Sepolia replacement https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/testnet-name-needed-for-sepolia-replacement/23221 Suggesting PyongYang as I have heard Kim would host future devcons with his ETH 😂 Anybody know who this is? It's been distributing hoodi Eth since yesterday, pushing up gasprices. https://hoodi.cloud.blockscout.com/address/0x1A90A8a4b4c96C5454BCE9CFdE7064bbEC6f85dE Wondering when it's done. Yea, it's us 🙂 Distributing 10 ETH to ~9M addresses, so everyone that had some funds on holesky is getting a small drop on hoodi too. It's about 190k transactions, with 50 transfers per tx. About 20 of them fit into a single block, so there's an average inclusion rate of 10 tx/block. Will take about 2.6 days to clear up 🙂 Gasprice for those distribution txs is capped at 200 Gwei, so it won't go higher than that. Hello, could I send you DM?
